macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a spiral lyrate trajectory, curving outward from the frontal bone before twisting inward and upward toward the apex.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips constitute approximately 12% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent white dorsal crest; elongated dark-pigmented hair fringe on the ventral neck and chest; distinct white facial chevron and two white malar spots.
